title: Chewbacca Roar
blurb: Ben Burtt assembled a Wookiee's entire emotional range out of bears, walruses, badgers and a lion, layering the recordings until they became a language. The genius is that Chewbacca expresses frustration, deep affection and mild scheduling disagreement using what is essentially the same sound, and audiences never once lose track of which one he means — a trick that says something flattering about human hearing. Play it when words have failed and only a roar will serve. Han Solo understood every word of it, and after two films so do you.
origin: Chewbacca's vocalisations from Star Wars, built from real animal recordings.
